body:
The tea is very disgusting. It's not as bad as san pedro but after a few sips I just didn't want to drink anymore of it. I used air tubing for a fish tank to enema the remaining liquid. Almost immediately I felt blood vessels in my lower abdomen and testicles open up and later my thighs and eventually my upper abdomen and feet. There was hardly any noticeable intestinal cramping or nausea.
The onset was sooner than my experience taking it orally but this being my first achuma trip I cant say for the potency. The cactus made itself clear that my insights were not to be shared but they were certainly had.
